0022600138.text: The Bucks (1-3, 12th in the East) host the Rockets (4-0, first in the Southwest), with Milwaukee at 1-1 at home and 1-3 over its last ten games. Houston has won all four of its games, including both road contests, and is on a four-game winning streak, but it will be without Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), who are both out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bucks lost both matchups in 2025-26, most recently 119-113 in Houston on April 1, 2026.
